name: Tabs
summary: Switch between sibling content panels from a tab bar — line, primary or card, in two sizes, with per-tab icons.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-tabs> — defined once, imported unchanged by React and Vue. The DS V3 Tabs is a family, not one look: `type` picks line (the default underline bar), primary (a Bold 700 emphasised underline) or card (a filled bg-accent segment), and `size` is default or small. Each tab can carry a leading icon (by name, via <aha-icon>) and be disabled — roving arrow-key nav skips it. Feed it slotted panels (each child's label in data-tab, optional data-icon / data-disabled) or an `items` JSON array for a label-only bar. Switching toggles a class on persistent tab nodes so the active colour, underline and pill animate. Zero drift — the same element, not two look-alikes.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. The primitive is defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

props.desc: Zero-based index of the active tab

props.desc: Underline (line), emphasised Bold underline (primary), or filled bg-accent segment (card)

props.desc: Label-only bar (no panels): [{key?,label,icon?,disabled?}]. Omit to use slotted panels instead

props.desc: The tab label for that panel; optional data-icon (icon name) + data-disabled

whenToUse.when: several peer content panels the user moves between within one screen
switching a compact view or mode, not larger panels
the choices are many or space is tight

opinion.note: Keep labels to one or two words, sentence case. Order tabs by expected use, most common first, and don't hide critical content behind a rarely-picked tab. Use line/primary for in-page view switching; reach for card when the bar sits on a tinted surface and needs a filled active chip.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — enumerated from the DS V3 reference contract, which carries two type families: `tabs|…` (the filled CARD look — active in a bg-accent pill, radius-sm 6, no rule) and `tabsPrimary|…` (the underline LINE look — active color-primary #6A1EBB text + 2px color-primary underline, inactive-hover lifting to color-primary), each with active / inactive / inactive|hover. Mapped to `type` = line (default underline) · primary (Bold 700 underline) · card (bg-accent pill). Both sizes (default / small) and per-tab leading icon + disabled supported. Token layer: border #E3E3E3, text-secondary inactive, color-primary active, bg-accent card fill, text-disabled disabled, radius-sm card. Colour, underline and pill animate on persistent nodes via the shared motion tokens — no subtree rebuild on switch.

conformance.$about: Measured by qa.mjs against the RENDERED UI (getComputedStyle via headless CDP). Leaf = ONE shared element, single render. The probe holds type=line value=0 so an active tab, an inactive tab and a disabled tab all exist. activeBorder asserts the line-type-specific state (a 2px color-primary underline — card would render transparent here).
